<p><span class="hover-note" tabindex="0" data-note="I believe all linguists are computational psycholinguists; they are just not aware of it yet.">Psycholinguist</span> and a PhD candidate in Linguistics at the University of Maryland, working with <a href="https://www.ellenlau.net" target="_blank">Ellen Lau</a> and <a href="https://www.colinphillips.net" target="_blank">Colin Phillips</a>. <em>I argue that existing models of sentence production cannot explain how speakers plan grammatical features, and that treating words as the units of planning is misleading.</em> My work investigates the real-time commitment to <strong>(morpho)syntactic</strong> choices of tense, case, and agreement, the competition between forms that decides them, and the <strong>unexplained variation</strong> in these choices across languages and tasks. I work mostly on Turkish and English, with production and reading experiments, eye-tracking, EEG, and computational models.</p>
<p>I also work on formal semantics and syntax, mostly of Turkish, including focus and polar questions, superiority effects, and allocutive agreement. I use language models to study why agreement errors differ across languages, and EEG to study how language builds mental objects. I have built treebanks for Turkish and Laz and shared tools for running speech experiments online.</p>
<p>Before Maryland, I did my MA at Boğaziçi University with <a href="https://plogacev.github.io/" target="_blank">Pavel Logačev</a> and spent time at Masaryk University with <a href="https://www.muni.cz/en/people/53172-pavel-caha" target="_blank">Pavel Caha</a> and at UMass Amherst with <a href="https://linguistics.mit.edu/user/smomma/" target="_blank">Shota Momma</a> and <a href="https://farukakkus.wordpress.com" target="_blank">Faruk Akkuş</a>.</p>
<p class="home-hero-note">My favorite food is <em>gata</em> with <em>koritz</em> and my favorite icecream flavor is saffron and rose (5pm snack of Anthony Bourdain). In my freetime, I like doing <a href="/calligraphy/">calligraphy</a>.</p>

### news
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
library(yaml)
HOWMANY <- 8

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || identical(a, "")) b else a

parse_news_date <- function(s) {
  s <- trimws(as.character(s %||% ""))
  if (grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", s)) {
    return(as.Date(s))
  }
  if (grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}$", s)) {
    return(as.Date(paste0(s, "-01")))
  }
  if (grepl("^\\d{2}/\\d{4}$", s)) {
    p <- strsplit(s, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    return(as.Date(sprintf("%s-%s-01", p[2], p[1])))
  }
  if (grepl("^\\d{4}$", s)) {
    return(as.Date(paste0(s, "-01-01")))
  }
  as.Date(NA)
}

fmt_news_date <- function(d) if (is.na(d)) "" else format(d, "%b %Y")

escape_html <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

valid_chr <- function(x) {
  !is.null(x) && length(x) > 0 && !is.na(x) && nzchar(as.character(x))
}

link_html <- function(url, label) {
  if (!valid_chr(url)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', escape_html(as.character(url)), label)
}

render_home_news <- function(limit = 10) {
  paths <- c("_data/news.yaml", "data/news.yaml")
  path <- paths[which(file.exists(paths))[1]]
  if (is.na(path)) {
    return('<ul><li><em>news.yaml not found</em></li></ul>')
  }

  x <- yaml::read_yaml(path)
  items <- if (!is.null(x$news)) x$news else x

  rows <- lapply(items, function(it) {
    d <- parse_news_date(it$date %||% "")
    links <- c(
      link_html(it$hlink %||% NULL, "handout"),
      link_html(it$alink %||% NULL, "abstract"),
      link_html(it$slink %||% NULL, "slides"),
      link_html(it$pdf %||% NULL, "pdf")
    )
    if (valid_chr(it$extra %||% NULL)) {
      links <- c(links, as.character(it$extra))
    }

    list(
      date = d,
      when = fmt_news_date(d),
      desc = as.character(it$description %||% ""),
      links = links
    )
  })

  ord <- order(
    vapply(
      rows,
      function(r) if (is.na(r$date)) as.Date("0001-01-01") else r$date,
      as.Date("0001-01-01")
    ),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
  rows <- head(rows[ord], limit)

  item_html <- vapply(
    rows,
    function(r) {
      suffix <- if (length(r$links)) {
        paste0(" · ", paste(r$links, collapse = " · "))
      } else {
        ""
      }
      sprintf("<li><time>%s</time> %s%s</li>", r$when, r$desc, suffix)
    },
    character(1)
  )

  paste0("<ul>\n", paste(item_html, collapse = "\n"), "\n</ul>")
}

knitr::asis_output(render_home_news(limit = HOWMANY))
```
